subdomain.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Processing
subdomain.capability: Continuous, high-throughput, non-blocking ingestion of raw 1Hz time-series sensor payloads (heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke telemetry) from IoT edge devices, bike computers and smart wearables; enforces Sensor Metric Boundaries, reconciles out-of-order backfills and buffers windowed telemetry streams for streaming analytics (PulseStream Engine).
subdomain.why_distinct: Core component of the endurance athletic analytics platform with its own language (Telemetry Sample, Ingress Packet, Backfill Reorder Window), cadence (1Hz bursts) and owned invariants (validation, chronological reordering, append-only history).

ubiquitous_language.definition: Individual 1Hz data point of a sensor metric.
Raw payload received from a device carrying Telemetry Samples.
Device-generated epoch timestamp; the chronological ordering key.
Arrival time at the ingestion entry point; never used for ordering.
60-second window within which delayed out-of-order packets are re-indexed by t_device.
Demand-driven flow control keeping ingestion non-blocking under burst load.
Physical physiological/mechanical limit a metric value must respect.
Status flag tagged on invalid samples; the payload is retained.
Appended record carrying a corrective or backfilled frame; never overwrites earlier records.

bounded_contexts.name: Sample Ingestion & Validation
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Accept Ingress Packets with backpressure and validate each Telemetry Sample against Sensor Metric Boundaries before downstream propagation.
invariants: Every incoming 1Hz Telemetry Sample is validated before downstream propagation (HR 30-240 BPM, Power 0-2500W, Cadence 0-220 RPM, Swimming Pace >45 sec/100m)
Invalid samples are tagged VALIDATION_FAILED and the underlying payload is never dropped
Ingestion entry point keeps backpressure control with zero blocking I/O on thread pools under burst load (thousands of simultaneous 1Hz transmissions)
source_of_truth: Validation status of a Telemetry Sample
consumes: Ingress Packet from IoT edge devices, bike computers, smart wearables

bounded_contexts.name: Backfill Reordering & Windowing
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Re-index delayed out-of-order samples chronologically by t_device within the 60-second Backfill Reorder Window and buffer windowed streams for streaming analytics.
invariants: Packets delayed up to 60 seconds are re-indexed chronologically on t_device rather than t_ingress
source_of_truth: Chronological ordering of samples within the window

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Event Log
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Append-only record of raw time-series records and corrective/backfilled revisions, preserving auditability.
in_scope: append of Event Revisions for corrections and backfills
out_of_scope: updates or deletes of existing records
invariants: Raw time-series records are strictly append-only
Corrective streams or backfilled frames append new Event Revisions, never mutate history
source_of_truth: Raw time-series history and its revisions

assumptions.item: Ambiguity/open question: transport posture of Ingress Packet delivery (at-most-once vs at-least-once) is not stated, and no dedup identity is named for the append-only log. If natural (device, metric, t_device), is the mutable payload value part of the identity or excluded, and what then separates a retry from a correction revision?
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Decides who in Telemetry Event Log distinguishes retries from corrections; a value-excluding identity would turn corrections into no-op duplicates.

assumptions.item: Operator list of metrics named without ranges, left unbounded/disabled pending an answer: ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke telemetry. Swimming Pace has only a lower bound (>45 sec/100m); no upper bound invented.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Validation in Sample Ingestion & Validation cannot flag these metrics until ranges are supplied.

assumptions.item: Description names one domain; split into three contexts by invariant ownership (validation, ordering, append-only history).
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Could merge into one context if consistency demands it.

assumptions.item: Backpressure-aware event broadcasting to downstream event streams is attributed to Backfill Reordering & Windowing; downstream consumers are outside this subdomain.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Broadcast could become a separate context if its rules grow.

assumptions.item: Samples arriving later than the 60-second window are unspecified; their handling (rejected, or appended as backfill Event Revisions) is undecided.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Affects Reordering vs Event Log responsibility for late data.
